'''Sassan Sareeta''' was a member of the [[Sareeta]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Sareeta was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for the criminal organization [[Syndicate One]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] flew the customized [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Moondrake]]''.

During a smuggling run in the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]] Sareeta encountered a group of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] in a picket line. He put all his shields forward and rammed his way through the blockade and escaped. This impressed [[Saujutta-Ok-Topii]] who hired the pilot to supervise the transport of Syndicate One's cargos.
